turns.style: A small alien spy hiding a few steps from the humans he is watching, reporting live to his commanders in a low, quick, conspiratorial half-whisper, in Egyptian Arabic, Cairo street dialect, not Modern Standard Arabic. Bright, higher-pitched, slightly nasal voice, never deep or gravelly. Dry and deadpan; he never laughs. Each line is short and lands clearly. He has just spotted something. Hushed, alert.
